changelog: A resumed movie no longer shows twice in Continue Watching. The engine now asks Jellyfin for each title's TMDB, IMDb and TVDB ids: without them, library syncs stored titles with no ids, and progress from a stream never carried over to the library copy. The next library sync fills in the missing ids. Includes 1.4.13.4: background trailer and theme jobs yield the CPU to playback. Requires Jellyfin 12.1 or later. This is a beta release.
description: Server-side intelligence engine for the Orca X TV app: personalization, recommendations, caching, and centralized administration.
